stories.title: Romanian F-16 fighter jets shoot down two drones over Romanian territorial waters
stories.summary: BUCHAREST, Oct 17 (Reuters) - Romanian F-16 fighter jets shot down two drones over the country’s territorial waters on Saturday, the defence ministry said. Defence Minister Radu Miruta said on Sunday the drones were likely latest generation Russian drones, flying at speeds similar to fighter jets. "The ones from last night were flying at 450 km/h, which leads us to think they were Russian-made Geran-4 drones with a turboprop engine," Miruta said. "This is the first time we’ve shot down drones like these." The drones were brought down days after two chemical tankers were hit by drones near Romania’s Black Sea coast, the latest in a series of attacks highlighting risks to commercial shipping on NATO’s eastern flank.

stories.summary: Rallies organized by the No Kings network opposed to President Donald Trump were held Saturday in cities and communities across the U.S., with an aim of getting people out to vote early in the midterm elections. The hundreds of planned events were billed as nonpartisan, though they sought to build on nearly two years’ worth of No Kings marches and demonstrations by people upset with Trump’s presidency. The hundreds of planned events were billed as nonpartisan, though they sought to build on nearly two years’ worth of No Kings marches and demonstrations by people upset with Trump’s presidency. A band entertained what appeared to be a few hundred people in caps and coats at the Lincoln Memorial in Washington. Despite the chilly weather, many in the crowd danced to the tunes. “VOTE EARLY” and “HANDS OFF MY VOTE!” were among the many signs held aloft.

Although many initiatives have delivered real innovations, not all have been successful.

reserveStories.title: University of Hawai’i system expands direct admissions to all 10 campuses
reserveStories.summary: The University of Hawai’i system will expand its direct admissions initiative to its flagship Mānoa campus beginning with the graduating high school class of 2027, broadening the program to cover all 10 of its institutions. Under the Direct2UH initiative, eligible students at Hawai’i public high schools can receive offers from the system’s community colleges and three universities. Interested students must submit a fee-free form by May 1 to receive acceptance offers for fall 2027 admission. Public college systems and states are increasingly turning to direct admissions programs to combat enrollment declines, increase access to postsecondary education and boost the share of workers with a degree. Direct2UH is a partnership between the UH system and the Hawai’i State Department of Education.

reserveStories.summary: Two species of damselfly have been recorded for the first time in a woodland after the completion of a three-year project to restore habitat across seven nature reserves, a wildlife trust has revealed. Work on the Ancient Astonbury and Wilder Woodlands project, in Hertfordshire, was made possible with a £162,698 grant from the National Lottery Heritage Fund. An increase in flowers attracted more butterflies, with Silver-washed Fritillaries also recorded in much higher numbers during summer 2026 than in previous years, the Herts & Middlesex Wildlife Trust said. The Beautiful Demoiselle and Willow Emerald damselflies were spotted at Astonbury Wood, close to Stevenage.

The discovery, known as altermagnetism, has revealed a third fundamental category of collinear magnetism and opened new possibilities for quantum materials, advanced electronics, and future computing technologies. Three physicists responsible for the breakthrough have been named recipients of the 2026 Europhysics Prize, one of Europe's most prestigious honors in condensed matter physics. reserveStories.summary: CorrespondentReporting fromTirana, Albania Demonstrators and riot police fought pitched battles in the centre of Tirana on Saturday for the fifth day in a row. The Wellcome Global Monitor 2026 surveyed more than 140,000 people in 140 countries in 2025 and found that trust in science had fallen below prepandemic levels. To track changes over time, researchers compared results from 108 countries surveyed in 2018, 2020 and 2025. The proportion of respondents expressing at least some trust in science fell from 77% in 2018 to 72% in 2025, after rising to 80% during the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020. Over the same period, the share reporting little or no trust in science rose from 13% in both 2018 and 2020 to 19% in 2025. Trust in scientists themselves also declined. reserveStories.summary: Terrence O'Brien is the Verge’s weekend editor. He’s covered the tech industry for over 18 years and knows a thing or two about synths. Just ahead of the wider release of Alex Gibney’s Musk documentary, TikTok has banned the film’s social media account from its platform. TikTok did not immediately respond to a request for comment. According to The Hollywood Reporter, the film’s distributor, Bleecker Street, was informed Friday afternoon that a “permanent suspension” was imminent. Bleecker Street has not yet responded to a request for comment from The Verge. While TikTok has no official affiliation with Elon Musk, part owner Larry Ellison appears in the film via a text message offering to help Musk fund his Twitter purchase.

reserveStories.title: France protests: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze as over 1,000 arrested
reserveStories.summary: Violence broke out across France on Saturday during the latest day of demonstrations against hardship in schools and the cost of living. At least 1,200 people were arrested during what the French government described as an "escalation in violence" alongside an estimated 550,000 taking to the streets. In Paris, there were significant clashes into the evening with riot police, who used tear gas and water cannon on crowds. Buildings were set alight in the capital and other areas, including in Limoges where a large fire in the town hall caused the roof to partly collapse. Looting broke out in several cities, with widespread vandalism targeting city halls and businesses also reported.
